    if [[ ! -z "${BRANCH}" ]]; then git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .; else git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .; fi

fi
if [[ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]]; then npm install; fi
echo "Installation complete"
